content: Pivot-based Method is a common strategy to obtain a source$\rightarrow $target model by introducing a pivot language. This approach is further divided into pivoting and pivot-synthetic. While the former firstly translates a source language into the pivot language which is later translated to the target language BIBREF4, BIBREF5, BIBREF12, the latter trains a source$\rightarrow $target model with pseudo data generated from source-pivot or pivot-target parallel data BIBREF13, BIBREF14. Although the pivot-based methods can achieve not bad performance, it always falls into a computation-expensive and parameter-vast dilemma of quadratic growth in the number of source languages, and suffers from the error propagation problem BIBREF15.
